strategies.name: Naive Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Performs 8 separate all_reduce dispatches with local bidiagonal coupling and decoupling operations between each stage, exactly as in the reference implementation. Total 8 all_reduce dispatches on full vector (world_size*1024 elements each). Maximizes dispatch count but simplest correctness guarantee; no fusion or pipelining.

strategies.name: Fused Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Pipeline
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing S-sized local shard) followed by all_gather (broadcast all shards). Allows overlapping local bidiagonal computation on received shards during all_gather phase. 16 collective dispatches (8 reduce_scatter + 8 all_gather) but enables computation-communication overlap and reduces intermediate buffer sizes by factor of world_size.

strategies.name: Chunked Ring All-Reduce with Sub-Stage Fusion
strategies.desc: Manually implement ring-based all_reduce for each of the 8 stages, splitting the W*S vector into C chunks and pipelining chunk transmission. Fuse bidiagonal coupling into the ring reduce-scatter phase where possible. Approximately 8*2*W/C dispatches (point-to-point sends/recvs per chunk per stage), trading more fine-grained communication for potential latency hiding.

strategies.name: Two-Level Hierarchical Reduce with Node-Local Buffering
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node structure by performing intra-node reductions (cores_per_device × num_devices per node) followed by inter-node all_reduce for each of the 8 stages. Apply bidiagonal coupling at node-granularity shards rather than rank-granularity. 16 dispatches (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node) with smaller inter-node payloads, optimizing for network topology.

strategies.name: Batch-Parallel Multi-Stage All-Reduce with Staggered Dispatch
strategies.desc:
Group the 8 dependent stages into pairs or triplets where legal, dispatching multiple all_reduce operations with different tags/streams to enable hardware-level parallelism. Pre-compute and buffer intermediate coupling transformations to minimize synchronization points. 8 all_reduce dispatches but scheduled non-blockingly with async operations, trading memory (extra buffers) for latency hiding via concurrent collective execution.
